ex3_captions.caption: to fly in a balloon
ex3_captions.scene: A man in a suit stands in the basket of a striped hot-air balloon high in the sky and waves. Fields, a river and small houses are far below.

ex3_captions.caption: to hold a balloon on the ground
ex3_captions.scene: A striped hot-air balloon stands on the grass. A man in a suit is in the basket, and a woman and an older man pull ropes on each side to hold it on the ground.

ex3_captions.scene: Close-up of a big wicker basket under a striped hot-air balloon, with burners above it and small sandbags on its side. A man in a suit stands next to it, one hand on the edge.
